title: lint.yml: setup steps may sit in the parallel group, but dependency install must follow it
answers: why does uv sync fail in the lint workflow after moving setup-python
can I put setup-python or setup-node inside the parallel block in lint.yml
where do the Python dependency install and problem matcher steps go in lint.yml
lint job runs steps concurrently, what must stay sequential
body:
Invariant: in .github/workflows/lint.yml, the `parallel:` block holds `setup-python`, `setup-node` and the independent cache restores. `Install Python dependencies` (`uv sync --locked --only-group lint --only-group pytest`) and the problem-matcher step come after that block, so they run once python and node are set up.
What breaks if skipped: a `uv sync` placed inside or before `parallel:` can run before `setup-python` has put uv and a Python interpreter on the runner, so the lint job fails at install.
Constraints: this is inferred from the step order in the diff, not from a reviewer comment. The PR description says install and matchers were left unchanged, but the diff moves them below the group, so treat the diff as the source of truth. Steps that do not depend on setup actions (for example `untracked`) stay before the group.
applies: The lint job in .github/workflows/lint.yml only; other workflows have their own ordering.
says: The linting check fails during package installation on the pull request checks screen.
Continuous integration crashes at the dependency install step before running code style checks.
Lint checks fail because the environment is not ready when installing project dependencies.
Ensure environment setup finishes before the automated lint check starts installing dependencies.
search: In `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, `setup-python`, `setup-node`, and cache restores run inside the `parallel:` block, while `Install Python dependencies` (`uv sync --locked --only-group lint --only-group pytest`) and problem matchers must run sequentially after it. Placing `uv sync` before or within the parallel block fails because uv and Python are not yet available on the runner. Steps independent of setup actions, such as `untracked`, remain before the parallel group.
